from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792484952/attempts/d113ac7d3c8446a89f045c03b3a31b6a/system/state/workspace/programs/task-2fd40492.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            comp = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                comp.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
            if len(comp) == 1:
                y, x = comp[0]
                neighbors = [grid[ny][nx] for ny,nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)) if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and grid[ny][nx] != color]
                if neighbors:
                    out[y][x] = Counter(neighbors).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
print(p)
